paragraphs: On Saturday, the family went to the town funfair. It was a hot day, and the sky was blue. A costume show was on the green. The music was loud, and the people clapped. Leo was a pirate with a long black beard. Mia was a famous pop star with a blond curly wig. Ben was a film star in big sunglasses. Sam wore a polar bear costume. He looked very hot. "You all look great!" said Mom. Pip sat next to Lily and watched the show. He had his red ball in his mouth.

Then Pip saw a cat and ran after it. He ran between the people with his red ball. "Where is Pip?" asked Lily. Tom looked all around, but he couldn't see him. "Pip is missing!" said Dad. The children went looking for him. Lily asked a man, "Did you see a small brown puppy?" "No, I didn't," said the man. Leo said, "I couldn't see him, but I looked at all the rides." Mia said, "I could hear a bark, but I couldn't see Pip."

Everyone looked for Pip at the rides. They went to a red chair near the rides. Pip was asleep under the chair with his red ball. Lily sat next to him and smiled. "Stay close, Pip!" she said. Pip woke up and jumped on her. "Pip didn't want to be a star," said Tom. "He wanted to play with his ball." Everyone laughed.
text.summary: The family goes to the town funfair. Pip runs after his red ball and is missing, but the children find him asleep under a chair.
